name: Belait
intro: Belait is Brunei’s largest district, known for its oil and gas heritage, forest recreation, wetlands, waterfalls and Iban longhouse culture around Labi.

places.name: Luagan Lalak Forest Recreation Park
places.why: Freshwater swamp and forest park with a boardwalk across the lake-like wetland landscape

places.name: Billionth Barrel Monument
places.why: Monument commemorating the production of Brunei’s billionth barrel of oil

places.name: Oil and Gas Discovery Centre
places.why: Interactive science centre focused on energy, engineering and the oil and gas industry; check current operating status

places.name: Teraja Waterfall
places.why: Forest waterfall reached by a walk through the Labi area; use a local guide and check river conditions

places.name: Teraja Longhouse
places.why: Iban longhouse community where visits and cultural introductions should be arranged in advance

places.name: Mendaram Besar Longhouse
places.why: Traditional Iban longhouse in the Labi area; arrange visits with the community before arrival

places.name: Wasai Wong Kadir
places.why: Forest waterfall and natural pools reached by a short jungle walk; check access and weather

places.name: Sungai Liang Forest Recreation Park
places.why: Forest recreation park with shaded trails and picnic areas

places.name: Lumut Beach
places.why: Coastal recreation area in the Lumut area

places.name: Kuala Belait Waterfront
places.why: Riverside and coastal town waterfront in western Brunei

places.name: Seria Energy Lab
places.why: Visitor attraction presenting Brunei’s energy story and petroleum heritage; verify current access and opening arrangements

places.name: Anduki Recreational Park
places.why: Recreation area near Anduki with open green space and a lake setting

places.name: Wasai Teraja
places.why: Waterfall and forest stream area near Teraja; visit with local guidance and avoid unsafe river conditions
